states: Private mock stack on pulse-dev (PULSE_MOCK_MODE, 4 nodes) built from this change with its embedded frontend, viewed in the Claude desktop Browser pane (Chromium) over an SSH tunnel. Thresholds lowered through PUT /api/alerts/config (node/agent CPU 3%, memory 10%, agent disk 5%, node temperature 20C, guest CPU 3%) plus one sensor override on agent:host-linux-1/sensor:<hex>, so canonical metric-threshold alerts fired on nodes, machines, machine disks, a machine sensor and guests.
Before (main build, same stack and config): Machines and Proxmox tabs rendered zero [title="Active alert"] elements with 60+ metric alerts open.

After, Machines tab at 1440x900: machine cards (AlertResourceTableMobile at that container width) lit CPU/Memory/Disk exactly where agent:<host> cpu/memory alerts or nested agent:<host>/disk: alerts were open; a scripted cross-check of all 88 rendered machine metric cells against /api/alerts/active found 0 mismatches (39 lit). Machine Disks table rows (AlertResourceTableRow) showed 13 dots for 13 open agent disk alerts; Machine Sensors table showed 1 dot for the 1 open sensor alert. backup-vault (PBS, no host-agent alerts) correctly showed none.

After, Proxmox tab at 1440x900: node cards lit only Temp for the 4 open node temperature alerts; linked-agent CPU/memory/disk alerts did not light the node rows' unused limits. Guest rows lit CPU; 69 rendered guest metric cells cross-checked against open alerts with 0 mismatches.
Narrow pass at 375x812 on the Machines tab: dots render beside the values in the card layout, no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth).
interactions: Opened the Machines and Proxmox threshold tabs, clicked Expand all, scrolled the app shell to the lit rows, and compared every rendered dot to the live /api/alerts/active list by resourceId and type.
Reloaded after swapping the main build for the fixed build on the same mock configuration (before/after).
